catalog.name: entity:loyalty.program
catalog.description: Complete definition of entity Loyalty Program (loyalty.program).

fields.name: pricelist_ids
fields.help: This program is specific to this pricelist set.

fields.name: date_from
fields.help: The start date is included in the validity period of this program

fields.name: date_to
fields.help: The end date is included in the validity period of this program

fields.name: trigger
fields.help:
Automatic: Customers will be eligible for a reward automatically in their cart.
        Use a code: Customers will be eligible for a reward if they enter a code.

fields.name: portal_visible
fields.help:
Show in web portal, PoS customer ticket, eCommerce checkout, the number of points available
         and used by reward.

fields.name: payment_program_discount_product_id
fields.help: Product used in the sales order to apply the discount.

fields.name: available_on
fields.help: Manage where your program should be available for use.

fields.name: pos_config_ids
fields.help: Restrict publishing to those shops. Note: A program will only be used in the shops using the same currency as the program.

fields.name: pos_report_print_id
fields.help: This is used to print the generated gift cards from PoS.

constraints.name: _check_max_usage
constraints.message: Max usage must be strictly positive if a limit is used.

validation_messages.message: The loyalty program's currency must be the same as all it's pricelists ones.
The validity period's start date must be anterior or equal to its end date.
A program must have at least one reward.

Returns the values to create a program using the template keys defined above.

be explicitly removed from an incoming vals dict unless, of course, it was actually a visible field.
